en.question: Discuss the significance of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment for local self-government in India. (150 words)
en.a: Local self-government is very important in any democracy. It brings government closer to people. The 73rd Amendment is a significant step for local government in India.
en.b: The 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 gave Panchayati Raj institutions constitutional status. It added Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule, which lists 29 subjects that may be devolved to panchayats. The answer will cover three dimensions: constitutional status, the three-tier structure and reserved seats for women.
en.why: B names the Act, year and 29 subjects, and signals its dimensions. A is generic and gives no fact.

hi.question: भारत में स्थानीय स्वशासन के लिए 73वें संविधान संशोधन के महत्व की चर्चा कीजिए। (150 शब्द)
hi.a: स्थानीय स्वशासन किसी भी लोकतंत्र में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है। यह सरकार को लोगों के करीब लाता है। 73वाँ संशोधन भारत में स्थानीय सरकार के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है।
hi.b: 73वें संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 ने पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया। इसने भाग IX और ग्यारहवीं अनुसूची जोड़ी, जिसमें 29 विषय सूचीबद्ध हैं और जो पंचायतों को हस्तांतरित किए जा सकते हैं। इस उत्तर में तीन पहलुओं पर चर्चा होगी: संवैधानिक दर्जा, त्रि-स्तरीय ढाँचा और महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षित सीटें।

en.question: Discuss the significance of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment for local self-government in India. (150 words)
en.a: The 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 gave Panchayati Raj institutions constitutional status, and it came into force on 24 April 1993. It provides a three-tier system in states with a population above 20 lakh, elections every five years by a State Election Commission, and at least one-third of seats reserved for women. This answer examines these provisions.
en.b: Local self-government is a topic that many people discuss in India. Views on it differ. The 73rd Amendment is one reform that shaped local government in the country.
en.why: A gives the Act, year, date and specific provisions, and previews the answer. B is vague and gives no fact from the source.
